title: Lie-Rinehart and Poisson algebras over $C^\infty$-rings
summary: We define the analogue of Lie-Rinehart algebras over $C^\infty$-rings. We show that given a Poisson $C^\infty$-ring $\mathcal{A}$ its module $Ω_{\mathcal{A}}^{1}$ of $C^\infty$-Kähler differentials is (part of) a Lie-Rinehart algebra.
